CRITICALSTART
The Critical Start Cybersecurity Advisory provides
simulations, workshops, and proof of concepts (POCs) to
help security teams properly explore the possibilities and
capabilities of Microsoft's XDR + SIEM solution stack.
Relying on years of experience, Critical Start analyzes
customer's needs while ensuring the solutions are
positioned to deliver real security outcomes. The objective
is to translate this knowledge to prevent, detect, contain,
and remediate threats.
